name: gharchive.org
what_it_holds: Source code for the GH Archive project itself (gharchive.org): crawling scripts, BigQuery integration/queries, and site content that together record and make queryable all public GitHub events (pushes, PRs, issues, stars, etc.) since 2011. MIT (code), CC-BY-4.0 (site content). 3.1k stars, 230 forks, 30 open issues, 146 commits. The event archive/data itself is hosted externally (BigQuery public dataset, gharchive.org hourly JSON.gz files), not committed to this repo.
why_useful: The canonical entry point for pulling Airbnb's own public-GitHub-org activity (commit/PR/star velocity across its 200+ public repos) as an engineering-investment / indirect headcount-growth proxy — gap #15. Method/pointer, not a committed dataset in the repo itself.
size_hint: external: full GH event archive (BigQuery / gharchive.org gz files), TBs
themes: Airbnb corporate footprint signals: careers/Greenhouse job-posting scrapers, LinkedIn headcount trackers, layoffs.fyi data, Glassdoor/Indeed review datasets, GitHub org activity (GH Archive)
why_all: The canonical entry point for pulling Airbnb's own public-GitHub-org activity (commit/PR/star velocity across its 200+ public repos) as an engineering-investment / indirect headcount-growth proxy — gap #15. Method/pointer, not a committed dataset in the repo itself.

name: OpenDigger
what_it_holds: Open-source analytics platform (X-lab) that processes GH Archive data into precomputed per-repo/per-org monthly metrics (OpenRank, commit counts, contributor counts, star/fork trends, activity indices), served as JSON files plus sample data directories and Jupyter notebooks; TS/Node primary implementation with Python variants. Apache-2.0, 1,083 commits, 17 open issues, 4 open PRs, actively developed.
why_useful: Directly usable to build a monthly time series of Airbnb's public-GitHub-org engineering activity (its ~200 public repos) without writing GH Archive/BigQuery queries from scratch — a ready-made input for the 'own GitHub org activity' engagement gap (#15) and, as an aside, a template for scoring any competitor's or partner's OSS output.
themes: Airbnb corporate footprint signals: careers/Greenhouse job-posting scrapers, LinkedIn headcount trackers, layoffs.fyi data, Glassdoor/Indeed review datasets, GitHub org activity (GH Archive)
why_all: Directly usable to build a monthly time series of Airbnb's public-GitHub-org engineering activity (its ~200 public repos) without writing GH Archive/BigQuery queries from scratch — a ready-made input for the 'own GitHub org activity' engagement gap (#15) and, as an aside, a template for scoring any competitor's or partner's OSS output.

name: sumaksharikaa/earnings-call-nlp
what_it_holds: Streamlit FinBERT sentiment app; README states the underlying source is 'Motley Fool scraped earnings call transcripts (2017-2022), 18,755 transcripts across 2,876 tickers' (a well-known Kaggle-hosted Motley Fool dump), of which the repo itself analyzes 514 transcripts across 30 companies/8 sectors. Does not commit the full 18,755-transcript set.
why_useful: Points to a broad multi-year, multi-thousand-ticker Motley Fool transcript corpus (2017-2022) that would include ABNB's 2021-2022 prints plus BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT/other travel peers over the same window — a candidate historical peer-transcript source if the Kaggle host is located.
duplicate_of_holding: ABNB transcripts already held since IPO; the incremental value is the peer/competitor coverage (BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT/Vrbo-adjacent names) in one uniform multi-year scrape.
themes: Earnings-call transcript datasets and NLP tooling (ECT datasets, Motley Fool scrapers, Seeking Alpha parsers), management-tone corpora
why_all: Points to a broad multi-year, multi-thousand-ticker Motley Fool transcript corpus (2017-2022) that would include ABNB's 2021-2022 prints plus BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT/other travel peers over the same window — a candidate historical peer-transcript source if the Kaggle host is located.

name: Sonith-Bingi/earnings-call-intelligence
what_it_holds: 43 NLP signals + 4 LLM agents cross-checking SEC filings, XGBoost/LightGBM overlay 'validated on 46K calls' (walk-forward AUC 0.643). Sources are external: Motley Fool transcripts via Kaggle (credentials required), SEC EDGAR 10-K/10-Q, yfinance prices. Coverage 4,386 tickers, Jan 2018-Dec 2025. Data is reconstructed at runtime via a pipeline script, not committed.
why_useful: Broader and more recent (through Dec 2025) version of the same Motley Fool Kaggle transcript corpus referenced above, plus a working SEC-filing-date-matching pipeline that is itself reusable tooling (gap 15, SEC EDGAR full-text tooling).
duplicate_of_holding: Same caveat as above — ABNB transcripts already held; value is in peer coverage and the reusable EDGAR-matching pipeline.
themes: Earnings-call transcript datasets and NLP tooling (ECT datasets, Motley Fool scrapers, Seeking Alpha parsers), management-tone corpora
why_all: Broader and more recent (through Dec 2025) version of the same Motley Fool Kaggle transcript corpus referenced above, plus a working SEC-filing-date-matching pipeline that is itself reusable tooling (gap 15, SEC EDGAR full-text tooling).

name: EarningsCall_Dataset (Qin & Yang, ACL 2019)
what_it_holds: Segmented earnings-call text + aligned audio for S&P 500 companies, ~2017 (e.g. 3M, Amazon, Twitter, Feb-Apr 2017). Folders named CompanyName_Date; text files hold CEO statements split sentence-by-sentence, audio files named Speaker_Paragraph_Sentence. Repo has a handful of example folders + a link to the full set as 5 split zip files on Google Drive (too large for GitHub). 24 commits, no explicit license. Built for the ACL 2019 volatility-prediction paper.
why_useful: Multimodal (text+audio) earnings-call corpus with a documented sentence-level structure; a template for building/verifying a similar ABNB-specific tone corpus and a source of peer (S&P 500) call data for cross-sectional tone/volatility benchmarking.
time_coverage: 2017 (sample folders); full set scope not independently confirmed
size_hint: few example folders in-repo; full corpus in 5 Google Drive zips (size unstated)
